cases.title: Prove local setup on a fresh installed ISO with repeatable evidence
steps: Run the standard ISO harness with 4096 MiB RAM and two virtual CPUs.
Observe anonymous read and mutation denial, invalid browser login, and valid installed-token login.
Choose Start new instead, reject incorrect recovery confirmation, then confirm through the real browser.
Reload the browser and restart omahabd to verify persisted setup choices.
Restart Caddy through the Applications page; verify a changed live PID and the application health action.
Enroll a device, deny cross-scope credentials, revoke it, and verify retained credentials fail.
Read the live PostgreSQL settings and installed worker generators without disabling applications.
Verify evidence/SHA256SUMS from the run artifact directory.
Repeat using report.json repeat_command on a fresh guest disk.
Force insufficient disk capacity and verify a FAIL report rather than a missing or passing artifact.
Record ISO size_bytes and hash from report.json; verify the newly compressed ISO installs and boots through the real harness.
Check successful installation and failed-command output for credential disclosure; check private log permissions.
expected: Browser requests reach the installed daemon without route mocks.
Unauthorized mutations cannot change recovery state.
Recovery acknowledgement and the correct code are required before confirmation.
Restore skipped and recovery confirmed remain persisted after reload and daemon restart.
Caddy has a new live PID and healthy rendered state; administrator and device credentials are not interchangeable.
Revocation denies the previously working device credential.
Desktop and narrow-screen screenshots contain no tokens or recovery phrases.
The artifact identifies source content, ISO hash, effective settings, checks, memory observations, and repeat procedure.
Each run has separate evidence; checksums verify its contents.
Failure and interruption never produce PASS.
The ISO size is recorded in bytes and matches the tested file; compression changes preserve successful installation and boot.
Terminal output contains fixed command labels and exit codes, without password commands or raw serial tails; the workdir is owner-only.
